design_philosophy: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level logistics marketing site. Clean, corporate, highly trustworthy, premium, and conversion-focused. Avoids AI-slop gradients. Uses 'The Swiss & High-Contrast' archetype adapted for deep navy and orange. Heavy reliance on structural grids, crisp 1px borders, generous spacing, and purposeful motion.

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter leading-[1.05] font-black
scale.overline: text-xs md:text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-accent

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px borders on items to create an open technical grid.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none). Primary CTA: bg-accent text-white hover:bg-primary hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300. Secondary: border border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-white.
components.cards: Flat solid surfaces, 1px border-border, no drop shadows. On hover: slight border-color shift to accent, zero Y translation for a grounded, heavy feel.
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults stripped of Vercel-look. Square corners (rounded-none), h-12, focus:ring-accent.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. Crucial for premium feel.
motion_and_interactions.reveals: Framer Motion. Headings use masked line-by-line reveal (overflow-hidden wrapper, text slides up from y: 100%). Sections use subtle fade + slide up (y: 20) with staggered children.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Micro-interactions: Buttons feature an internal sweep effect or solid color swap. Images in galleries feature subtle scale-up (scale: 1.05) on hover with overflow-hidden.

hero.layout: Min-h-[90vh] relative flex items-end pb-24 pt-32
hero.visuals: Large background image of logistics trucks on highway. Overlay: bg-[#0A1128]/70 to ensure contrast. Use subtle parallax on background image using framer-motion.
hero.content: Kinetic typography. Masked line-by-line reveal for 'India\'s Trusted Logistics Partner'. 'Get Free Quote' and 'Our Services' CTAs.
hero.stats: Bottom bar of hero or just below: 4 data points separated by 1px vertical borders (25+ Years / 10,000+ Deliveries / 500+ Clients / 98% On-Time).

marquee.visuals: Slow editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee. 'FTL • PTL • EXPRESS CARGO • WAREHOUSING • PAN INDIA'.

about.layout: Grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 py-32 container
about.content: Mission, Vision, Core Values. Col-span-5 for Text, Col-span-7 for large warehouse image treated with clipped frame (offset 1px border box).
about.accent: Numbered manifesto chapters style for core values.

services.grid: High Density Bento Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-0 border-t border-l border-border container
services.items: 8 premium cards. Each has border-b border-r border-border p-8. Crisp, flat, industrial. Icons top-left, title, brief text.

why_choose_us.items: 8 icon cards. Top numeric indicator (e.g., '01') in accent color, large and bold.

industries.items: 8 items, each bg-primary p-8. Hover: bg-white/5 transition-colors.

fleet_gallery.visuals: Horizontal scroll or tightly packed asymmetric grid (Tetris Mode) of premium truck images. Spotlight treatment: images are desaturated until hover. Sharp rectangles, no rounded corners.

process_timeline.visuals: 6 steps. Use Aceternity 'Tracing Beam' inspired line connecting steps vertically on mobile, horizontally on desktop.

testimonials.visuals: Carousel or 3-column Grid. Sharp cards. Indian names, ratings (stars in accent), small grayscale portraits.

faq.visuals: Shadcn Accordion. Sharp corners, 1px bottom border per item. No backgrounds.

contact.layout: py-32 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 container
contact.visuals: Left: Large typography, contact details, embedded Google Map (grayscale filter). Right: Contact form with Shadcn (client-side validation), WhatsApp button (bg-[#25D366] text-white).

footer.visuals: 4 columns in container. Quick links, Services, Industries, Contact. Bottom bar with Copyright and Socials.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure 'lenis' for smooth momentum scrolling. Wrap the app in a Lenis provider.
Install 'framer-motion' for all scroll reveals and the kinetic hero.
Install 'react-fast-marquee' for the editorial marquee section.
Install 'lucide-react' for all iconography (services, why choose us).
Strictly adhere to the CSS variables. Do not introduce any generic tailwind colors like blue-500 if they deviate from the palette.
Do NOT use HTML input elements directly; rely heavily on Shadcn 'Form', 'Input', 'Textarea' and 'Accordion'.
Customize Shadcn components to use `rounded-none` and sharp 1px borders to match the industrial feel.
Ensure all interactive elements have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
Hero image must have an overlay to ensure white text is readable. Never use transparent headers without a solid or highly blurred background.
No backend logic, completely static site.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold: use the provided structural grid, sharp borders, and bold typography.
Do not use generic centered layouts. Asymmetry creates tension; tension creates interest.
Create depth through high contrast (Deep Navy vs White) rather than drop shadows.
Never apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Use 2-3x more spacing than usual (`py-24` or `py-32` for sections).
Include a `data-testid` attribute on all interactive and key informational elements.
